dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: My home is a country that reveres true beauty and elegance.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Some people from other countries may find our dress sense showy and impractical, but for us, there is nothing more commonplace.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still, I've had to buy new clothes yet again recently. I swear it's the food in Liyue. It's so good, I must have put on two hundred pounds after coming here!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: All that said, a man must eat. This is really good!
